moments.blurb: Remembrance Day, also known as Armistice Day, is observed on November 11 each year, commemorating the end of World War I with a two-minute silence at 11am.

angles.copy: On Wednesday at 11am, we observe the two-minute silence for Remembrance Day. Join us in honouring those who have served and sacrificed. #RemembranceDay
